title: Spider Goddess Ritual
description: A surreal black and white scene depicts a multi-armed spider-like goddess with a pale grinning face and ornate headdress, hovering above a pile of offerings. Below, white-robed cultists kneel in a circle around the altar performing a ritual with candles, red bowls, and floating rings amid swirling blue smoke, framed by spider illustrations in the corners.
prompt: Surreal black and white illustration of a multi-armed spider goddess with pale grinning face, ornate patterned headdress, and extra limbs holding a lantern and golden rings. She hovers above a central pile of dark offerings as white hooded cultists kneel in a circle around an altar with lit candles, red bowls, and swirling teal smoke. Corner borders feature spider drawings, dark occult atmosphere with stars in the background.
